title: Production Methods Adventure
welcome_lead: How are products actually made? Step inside the factory. 🏭
meta_desc: People & Operations Adventure 2 — KS3 Business Studies on job, batch and flow production methods.
final_note: You learned three production methods and where each is used.

concepts.def: Output per worker or per hour

walkthroughs.body_html:
Job production makes one special item at a time.

Examples: a wedding cake, a tailored suit, a Ferrari. ✂️

It's slow and pricey — but unique.

Batch production makes a group of the same item, then switches.

A bakery makes 100 white loaves, then 100 brown ones.

More efficient than job, more flexible than flow.

Flow production is a non-stop assembly line.

Cars, drinks cans and chocolate bars roll out 24/7.

Very cheap per item but very expensive to set up. 🚗
